task_description: Predicting and optimizing the space-time yield of higher alcohols (STYHA) for FeCoCuZr catalysts under syngas conversion, while simultaneously minimizing selectivity to undesired by-products CO₂ and CH₄, through active learning-guided experimental design across composition (Fe/Co/Cu/Zr molar ratios) and reaction conditions (H₂:CO ratio, temperature, pressure, GHSV).

datasets.db_description: A curated experimental dataset comprising 86 catalytic experiments on FeCoCuZr compositions and reaction conditions, with measured outcomes including space-time yield of higher alcohols (STYHA), CO₂ selectivity (SCO₂), CH₄ selectivity (SCH₄), CO conversion (XCO), and higher alcohol selectivity (SHA). Each entry includes XRF-verified elemental composition (mol% Fe, Co, Cu, Zr) and reaction parameters (H₂:CO, T, P, GHSV). This dataset is used to train and iteratively refine Gaussian process surrogate models within a Bayesian optimization framework to predict and guide the discovery of high-performing catalysts.

datasets.db_title: Seed Dataset from Prior FeCoZr/FeCuZr/CuCoZr Study
datasets.db_description: A set of 31 experimental data points on related ternary catalysts (FeCoZr, FeCuZr, CuCoZr) reported in Ge et al., ACS Catal. 13, 9946–9959 (2023), serving as initial training data ('seed experiments') for Phase 1 of the active learning workflow. It contains composition (mol%), STYHA, and fixed reaction conditions (H₂:CO = 2.0, T = 533 K, P = 50 bar, GHSV = 24,000 cm³ h⁻¹ gₜₐₜ⁻¹), and is used to bootstrap the GP-BO model before any new FeCoCuZr experiments are conducted.
